title: Studio B Suite 4BR/3000sq ft, Walkable to Broadway
description:
Experience Nashville in style at the 3000 sq ft Studio B Suite by Maddox Hotel! Ideal for bachelor/bachelorette gatherings, special occasions, corporate retreats, executive getaway or business meetings. This spacious 4-bedroom apartment that sleeps 16, offers a prime downtown location and is packed with amenities including a kitchen, air conditioning, and pool table. Enjoy easy access to Broadway, Printers Alley, museums and the best of Music City. Perfect for groups, this apartment provides com

The space
Step inside the Studio B Suite and discover a meticulously designed space perfect for groups. This spacious apartment boasts four private bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, and 8 beds that sleep 16, each offering a tranquil retreat. Bedroom one features 2 queen-size beds. Bedrooms two and three each offer a luxurious king-size bed, providing ample space for relaxation. The 4th bedroom has 2 queen size beds and 2 full size beds in a bunkbed style. Each of the four full bathrooms is designed for your comfort, offering essential amenities. The apartment's common areas include a well-equipped kitchen, a dining area, and a living space. Enjoy the convenience of a pool table for entertainment. The entire suite is designed with your comfort and convenience in mind, ensuring a memorable stay in the heart of Nashville.

Guest access
Guest entrance is at 200 6th Ave N.  Suite 401 is accessible via elevator with its own private lobby.

Other things to note
Upon arrival, you will find a Welcome Book containing all the information you need relating to your stay.  If you have any questions, just message us anytime! Happy to help!
